blind_answers.description: One entry per question (or exercise item) answered blind, without the key. Empty for review-only items.

id.description: Question number ("7") or exercise item id.

answer.description: Answer in the exact form a candidate must write: option key, TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN, YES/NO/NOT GIVEN, or words copied from the text within the word limit.

evidence.description: Short verbatim quote that supports the answer (for NOT GIVEN, what the text does and does not say).

id.description: Question number / item id, or "item" for whole-item problems.

severity.description: blocker = a real candidate could dispute the answer, or the item breaks IELTS format/accuracy.

verdict.description: PASS only when there are no blocker issues.
